title: Entry specification: stability and kind of a public entry without a primitive or styled specification (TDD primitives P13, P20)

hookScope.description: Where a product sets the hooks: on a scope it owns, not on :root, and on [data-<option>] within that scope to change one option value (TDD styled HK5). Required when hooks are listed.

hooks.description: Tier-3 component hooks (ADR-UIP-VIS-001 item 8; STD-UIP-TKN-001 2.7.0, Hook mechanics; TDD styled HK2, HK7): every --scnx-* hook the component's stylesheet reads, the properties it sets, the values it falls back to, and the floor that bounds it. Checked against the stylesheet in both directions; a hook is public API.

parts.description: The anatomy parts whose rules read the hook.

fallbacks.description: Each fallback as a binding template: a token as {path}, or a keyword or recorded literal.

floor.description: The guarded floor the component enforces around the hook, for example 24px (the target size, WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8); null when none.

purpose.description: Alias review (STD-UIP-TKN-001, Component Alias Review): what the hook changes.

coverage.description: Alias review: the themes, modes, options, and states it covers.

migration.description: Alias review: when it was added and what a consumer changes.
